units.source_text: 名人勉强下了两盘练习棋，显得吃不消的样子，

en.t: The Master forced himself through two practice games, and he seemed unable to bear it,

units.source_text: 仿佛手指夹不住棋子，落棋子也是轻轻的，没有声音。

en.t: as if his fingers could not hold the stones, and even when he placed them down, he did so softly, without a sound.

units.source_text: 下第二盘时，他有时显得呼吸困难，眼睑有点浮肿。

en.t: During the second game, at times he appeared to have trouble breathing, and his eyelids were slightly swollen.

units.source_text: 虽然是朦朦胧胧，我回想起了名人在箱根的情景，感到他的病没有痊愈。

en.t: Though only dimly, I recalled how the Master had been in Hakone, and felt that his illness had not yet healed.
